snippet.title: Critter Escape! - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Critter Escape is an action-packed mobile game available on iOS and Android featuring more than 120 levels and 10 distinct environments. It features simple, one-touch controls and offers players unique challenges, bonus levels and the chance to unlock hidden content.

Visit www.critterescape.com for more information.  Follow us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/PlanetMuck or Twitter at www.twitter.com/MuckCritter.
